title: Billing Error Correction Standard for Assisted Living Accounts
content:
**Clause.** A charge posted in error on an Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement account — a wrong care level, a wrong rent, an add-on the care level includes, a duplicate posting — is corrected only by a billing error credit referencing the exact charge entry; charges are never deleted. The credit may not exceed that charge less credits already posted against it, and the correct charge, where one is due, is posted again as a new entry. Each charge entry receives at most one billing error credit.

**What is not a billing error.** A care level that matches the band of the latest assessment is not a billing error, and a family's disagreement with an assessment is handled by requesting a change-of-condition reassessment, never by a credit.

### Condition — judgement — result (hypothetical entries)

| Charge entry | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Escort assistance fee of 295.00 billed at a care level that includes escorts | Add-on the level includes: posted in error | Billing error credit of up to 295.00 less credits already posted against it, referencing that entry |
| Care fee charged twice for the same month | Duplicate posting | Billing error credit referencing the duplicate entry |
| Care fee at Assisted Living Care Level 3 where the latest assessment scored 38 points | Level matches the band of the latest assessment | Not a billing error; no credit |
| A charge that already carries a billing error credit | One billing error credit per entry | No second billing error credit |

**Arithmetic of the ceiling (hypothetical).** A rent charge of 4285.00 against which a credit of 300.00 already stands can receive a billing error credit of at most 3985.00, that is 4285.00 less 300.00.
